mprQRCode.Description: Generating QR codes from links in element parameters
mprQRCode.t1: Parameters with the "URL" data type available on model elements are shown.
mprQRCode.t2: Parameters with the "Image" data type available on model elements are shown.
mprQRCode.t3: There are no parameters with the "Image" data type in the document. Add a shared parameter or a project parameter and assign it to the required categories.
mprQRCode.t4: Affects the image resolution, but not the code size in the schedule - the size there is set by the column settings.
mprQRCode.t5: The higher the value, the better the code reads when printed, but the larger the project file size.
mprQRCode.t6: An instance parameter is selected: the QR code will be written to each element separately. A single image is created for identical links, but the number of filled parameters and the project file size will grow noticeably. A type parameter is recommended for standard products.
mprQRCode.m2: Parameter with link is not selected
mprQRCode.m3: Parameter for QR code is not selected
mprQRCode.m7: The link is too long for a QR code: {0} characters
mprQRCode.m10: The selected categories do not have the parameter "{0}"
